messages:
Priya: Quick postmortem follow-up for the token-ttl drift incident. Main remediation themes: automated TTL drift detection, targeted audit log recovery, tightening staging SA RBAC, and deploy-time cache-warmup. Assigning owners and timelines here.

Jordan: I'll own TTL drift detection. Approach: daily sampling job comparing secret metadata vs rotation schedule, emit a low-volume PagerDuty if >3% of tokens are stale. Also add Grafana dashboard and an alert suppression window to avoid noisy spikes. ETA: 4 business days. Issue: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/issues/2609

Sam: I'll do audit log recovery. Plan: reprocess S3 chunks for the 8-hour outage window, reconcile against metrics (auth.success/failed) and publish a verification report. Will build a small reingest lambda + checksum validation. ETA: 6 working days. Branch: ops/audit/reingest-2609

Alex: I'll take the staging SA fix. Found `staging-runner-sa` with wildcard verbs in two namespaces. I'll scope the role to only the necessary pods/cronjobs and add an automated infra-ci gate that fails on wildcards. Expect PR tomorrow morning.

Lee: Noted a recurring pattern: auth.jwks.fetch_fail spikes coincide with deploys that include a schema change to jwks cache keys. Mitigation: add a cache-warmup step in the deploy pipeline and a deploy-time healthcheck that validates JWKS reachability. Draft pipeline change: /docs/pipeline/jwks-warmup.md

Priya: For short-term mitigation, Jordan — can you add a staging-only fail-closed toggle for validation so we can exercise the fix without production risk? Also add clear rollback instructions to the runbook: https://confluence.redwood/incident-runbooks/token-ttl-drift (please add your mitigation notes).

Jordan: Yes. I'll add a feature flag gated by env var and a runbook section with rollout/rollback commands. Will also emit a metric auth.token.fail_closed.{on,off}.

Maria: incident-bot recorded the deploy event: "deploy auth-service v3.3.0 -> healthcheck failures". Logs moved to S3: s3://redwood-incident-logs/3519998888/*.log. Metric snapshot: auth.jwks.fetch_fail = 320 at peak.

Sam: Example log showing jwks fetch failures and cache expiration:
```
ERROR auth/jwks: fetch failed for kid=G7d1 err=timeout request=req-99f
WARN auth/cache: local-jwks expired for kid=G7d1 fallback_missing=true
```
I'll add retry-with-backoff and a read-through local cache backed by a fallback snapshot.

Alex: Opened draft PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/978 to restrict staging SA and added unit tests for RoleBinding linting. CI currently failing on flaky namespace fixture, fixing.

Jordan: Posted initial TTL-drift alert PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/ops/pull/583. Needs review from security and oncall.

Priya: Let's do a short checkpoint next Monday 11:00am PT to confirm PRs merged and runbook updates. Owners: please link PRs in the GH issues before the checkpoint and mark test coverage for the revert path. :calendar:

Lee: Added cache-warmup job to the deploy pipeline draft; will open PR for deployment repo by EOD.

incident-bot: Reminder created: Token-ttl follow-up checkpoint in 6 days (https://calendar.redwood/3519998888-checkpoint).
